additional_info.subject: ID0471392-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/T04002918666] Connectivity Issue CRM:03289000190
additional_info.body:
Dear Lara-Anna,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your request and after checking the charger we see that the secc went offline multiple times during the last few days.
The cause behind this is
a communication issue between the charger and the EV. The handshake between the charger and the EV failed and that is when the secc goes offline.
We do see that the charger is in a stable and healthy condition now. We will keep an eye on the charger for the next three days, to see if the problem occurs again.
Please provide us with feedback if you are still facing issues with the charger.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
